'''Jaffro Davengatt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] entrepreneur who established the farm [[Davengatt's Double-Zed Nerf Ranch]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Engebo V]] at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. Davengatt's business specialized at producing high-quality [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] meat that commanded high prices, and the operation brought prosperity to Engebo V. However, Davengatt became reclusive and he focused on adding gadgets to his mansion, delegating the day-to-day running of his business to his daughter, [[Nell Davengatt]]. However, after the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Goontirk]] inadvertently introduced [[skekfish]] to Engegbo V, the creatures infested the planet and devoured Davengatt.
